Whether TX-0401 can be disputed depends on the reason, and you have not yet told me what happened. I can run the eligibility check once you choose one of the reason codes:

- **duplicate_charge**: you were charged twice for the same purchase (TX-0401 and TX-0402 are both EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online).
- **unauthorized_debit**: you did not authorise the payment.
- **fraud_card_not_present**: the card details were used without your involvement.
- **goods_not_received**: you paid for goods you did not receive.
- **service_not_rendered**: you paid for a service that was not provided.

Which of these matches your situation? If none does, describe what happened and I will suggest the closest code. I will check eligibility first, and I will not open a dispute until you confirm.
